ValidationRule.description: This validation rule will control the mobile phone format to ensure it fit Hungarian format, as following : +36-11-111-1111 (mobile phones)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c), ER_Business_Unit__c = 'HU', NOT( OR( LEN(MobilePhone) = 0, REGEX(MobilePhone, "[+36]{3}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{3}-[0-9]{4}") )))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The format of the Mobile Phone must be equal to Hungarian format, as following : +36-11-111-1111 (mobile phones)
